description: The plot illustrates how the “Similarity” of HSAs varies across transformer layers for four language pair settings in the Qwen1.5-1.8B model, with four colored lines shown together. The x-axis is labeled “Layer,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 23, with numeric tick labels shown at regular intervals of 2 (0, 2, 4, …, 22). The y-axis is labeled “Similarity,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.00 up to 0.45 with evenly spaced tick marks every 0.05. The red solid line (en&en) starts near 0.07 at layer 0, rises to about 0.10–0.12 by layers 2–4, reaches a local high around 0.26 at layer 6, drops to roughly 0.16 by layer 7–9, stays around 0.17–0.18 near layers 10–12, declines to about 0.12–0.13 around layers 15–16, decreases further to roughly 0.08–0.09 around layers 19–21, and then rises sharply to about 0.18 at layer 22 and approximately 0.43 at layer 23. The blue solid line (en&es) begins around 0.06 at layer 0, increases to about 0.09–0.11 by layers 2–4, peaks near 0.24 at layer 6, falls to around 0.15–0.16 by layers 7–9, sits near 0.16–0.18 around layers 10–12, declines to roughly 0.11–0.12 around layers 15–16, reaches about 0.05–0.06 around layers 20–21, and then increases to about 0.13 at layer 22 and approximately 0.27 at layer 23. The green solid line (en&el) starts near 0.04 at layer 0, climbs to around 0.07–0.08 by layer 2, dips to about 0.05–0.06 around layer 3, rises to a local high near 0.15 at layer 6, drops to about 0.10 around layer 7–8, increases again to roughly 0.13–0.15 around layers 10–12, declines to about 0.09 around layers 15–16, reaches roughly 0.04–0.05 around layers 19–21, and then rises to about 0.12 at layer 22 and approximately 0.30 at layer 23. The magenta solid line (en&bn) begins around 0.03–0.04 at layer 0, rises to about 0.06–0.07 by layer 2, dips near 0.05 around layer 3, increases to about 0.14 at layer 6, drops to roughly 0.09–0.10 around layer 7–8, increases to about 0.12–0.14 around layers 10–12, declines to around 0.08–0.09 around layers 15–16, reaches about 0.05–0.06 around layers 19–21, and then increases to roughly 0.14 at layer 22 and about 0.29–0.30 at layer 23.
